title: Not what I expected
text: Not what I expected. The coloring of this is really nice, but other than that, it is really quite cheaply made. Three of the "rungs" of the ladder are exactly the same size, with the fourth smaller at the top. It doesn't really look like a "ladder". It lacks stability and was not easy to put together. While there are instructions in the box, the pieces are not marked, so you just have to do a lot of guessing and patiently try to match up holes. I became very frustrated when it was apparent that it just was not going to be sturdy and that it was not going to align with the wall. Bummer.
